description: This file is a test script for Lua's math library, performing extensive tests and assertions on numeric limits, floating-point precision, conversions, mathematical operations, and random number generation. It serves as a comprehensive validation suite for the math module functionality.

methods.name: isNaN
methods.description: Function to check if a number is NaN by comparing it to itself.

methods.name: checkerror
methods.description: Utility to assert that a given function call results in an error message containing a specific substring.

methods.name: eq
methods.description: Function to compare two floating-point numbers within a specified limit for approximate equality.

methods.name: eqT
methods.description: Function to compare two values for equality and also check their math.type results.

methods.name: testnear
methods.description: Function to verify if a value is within a certain tolerance of a reference value.

methods.name: aux
methods.description: Various auxiliary functions used in random distribution testing, comparing ranges and ensuring coverage.
